title: Week Without Driving Las Vegas
summary: The campaign site for Week Without Driving Las Vegas, October 1-8, 2026. Las Vegans sign up to win LVBT's giveaway by sharing trips without driving, and use rider guides, a bus stop finder, and an offline-capable Digital Transit Bingo.

previewImage.alt: Dark card reading Las Vegas, October 1-8, 2026, Week Without Driving: take one trip without a car, post it, see the Valley the way 1 in 3 people do. lvwwd.org, a campaign by Las Vegans for Better Transit.
